_doc: The pickable skaters (client only; read by src/client/skater/characters.ts and view.ts). rig: proportions in metres (see RigSpec in kit.ts); heights from the sole. poseRig: the rig data/poses.json was written for; each character's poses are retargeted from it at draw time (hip height keeps each pose's knee bend, hand offsets scale with arm length). style: bend scales the spine and hip turns of the poses (1 = as written), arms scales how far the hands swing out, stretch lets cartoon limbs stretch up to that factor to reach the board, swing is the arm swing while rolling, celebrate is the landing celebration from small to huge, idle is the fidget when standing still, emote is the taunt (T, or grind when standing still): a kind (mood.ts, specials.ts) and the line it says; outfits are the alternates the picker offers (colour overrides and parts the builder adds: crushed, jersey, slicker, hoodie, sunglasses, glow, golden, logo, playa, thick, wet); lazy characters are built the first time they are picked (or worn by an NPC), not at startup; bio is the two lines the picker shows; board is its deck (graphic in decks.ts, wheel colour); idles are the fidgets it cycles standing still (the first after a second, the rest after 8 s); flair.bail is how it falls apart in a bail (bails.ts: dent, splat, ball, headPop, bats, pile, slowmo); signature is its flourish in the three specials (specials.ts: foam, gelatin, giggle, bighead, bat, apart, selfie); flair is how the character catches flips (a pose in poses.json), tweaks grabs (board roll, pitch, yaw in degrees) and holds its free arm in grabs; walk is the gait on foot (Gait in gait.ts: how the board is carried and in which hand, stride, foot lift, bob, bounce, waddle roll, arm swing, lean). colors are sRGB hex. unlock: a secret skater, locked until the Tour career has that many secret tapes (tapes) or goals (goals), or has finished a level (level: every goal of that Tour level done); hint is what the picker shows over its silhouette (src/client/unlocks.ts). style.bailSay: a line in the toast when it bails. style.wings: free hands held out wide like wings while riding (0..1, the sea lion's flippers). style.secondary: the loose parts' follow-through (the mascot's ears, the vampire's cape; characters.ts hooks): land (radians the part swings on a landing, a damped wave of decay ticks and freq radians per tick), air and fall (as it rises or falls), speed (lying back with speed), idle (a twitch standing).

spectators._doc: The watchers sitting on the park's ledges (src/client/spectators.ts, view only). Seats are tried every step metres along park rails of these kinds, where one side is a flat top (depth metres of it) and the other drops between drop[0] and drop[1] metres (feet on the ground below a low ledge, legs hanging over a high one); the seats furthest apart are kept, up to max, no closer than spacing. They cheer when a combo of at least cheer.points lands within cheer.near metres (bigPoints: within bigNear), for cheer.ticks. Colours are picked from the lists with seed. areas: more watchers sitting on steps (the city's EMB steps, which have no rails): seats within r metres of at, facing that way (down the steps), on a tread with depth metres of it behind and the next step drop metres lower, up to max, spacing metres apart.

npcs._doc: How the NPC skaters are drawn (src/client/npcs.ts): each NPC's look (0-999) picks a character and outfit, stepping on to another character if it is the player's. Not drawn beyond maxDistance metres or off screen. Beyond nearDistance metres an NPC is drawn with its baked far rig (skater/lod.ts: every part merged into a few skinned meshes on the same bones); nearer, parts whose bounding radius is under detail x distance are dropped (eyes and buttons first), real fur shells beyond furDistance metres; only parts at least shadowRadius metres across cast shadows. Beyond halfRateBeyond metres the pose is solved every other frame.

react._doc: How a park NPC reacts (src/client/skater/react.ts, from its Thing; ticks at 120 Hz). Cheer (npc.life.cheer, the sim's npcCheer): arms up for cheerTicks while the back foot taps the kicktail taps times, every tapEvery ticks from tapFrom, the nose kicking up tapPitch degrees and slapping down (a clack each in the game's sound). Point (it starts copying your line: npc.life.copy, placed at your start): the nearer hand points at you for pointTicks. Waiting for its turn at a spot (act 'wait'): off the board on the toe side, the back foot resting on it and rolling it a little, blended in over waitBlend ticks and out over waitLeave; it looks at the nearest skater riding (faster than lookSpeed m/s, within lookRange m), turning head then shoulders up to lookMax degrees, easing over lookEase ticks.

locals._doc: The EMB and Pier 7 locals (src/client/npcs.ts, main.ts): an NPC riding one of these lines wears one of these looks (its look number picks), never the player's character; and within range metres of you a local says something (data/voices.json lines, spoken and captioned) when it cheers your combo (cheer), when you bail (bail) or when it sets off copying your line (copy), at most once every cooldown seconds.

pop._doc: The floating combo over a park NPC that lands one (the sim's npcCombo; src/client/tags.ts npcPopTags, drawn by the HUD in the game and in clips): the combo name (at most maxName characters) over its points and multiplier, smaller than the player's, for seconds, rising rise px, fading in over fadeIn and out over fadeOut seconds; not beyond range metres or when the NPC is hidden behind something.

board._doc: The board's own motion (src/client/skater/view.ts boardMotion, view only): the hangers stay level as the deck rolls in a carve (truckLevel, 1 = fully) and steer into the turn by truckSteer of the lean (front one way, back the other); the wheels spin at speed / radius, at most spinMaxStep radians a frame so fast wheels do not strobe backwards; the deck bows down by flexLand metres in the middle as it lands (scaled by the impact) and springs the other way by flexPop at the pop, over about flexTicks ticks.

squash._doc: Landing squash and stretch (view.ts landingSquash) after a landing from more than minAir ticks of air: down by amount times each character's style.squash (the blob and Karl most, the can least, people none), scaled by the impact between impact[0] and impact[1] m/s (a quarter at least), up past it and settling (decay ticks, rate rad/tick), keeping the volume.

ghost._doc: The hill bomb race ghost (src/client/ghostview.ts): the player's character and outfit in one see-through tint, no shadow, no face decals.

characters.name: Can of Hella Fría
bio: Born in a Mission bodega fridge, two for five bucks.
Specialty: the Shotgun Superman. Leaves a ring on every ledge.

characters.name: Big Blob
bio: Fell off a parade float on Market St and kept rolling.
Splats off Big 3, walks it off. Mostly made of fog.

characters.name: Eucalyptus Monster
bio: Moved here for a fuzzy hat startup. Lives rent-free in Sutro Forest now.
Still giggles at every kickflip, mostly his own.

characters.name: Guy in the Orange Suit
bio: Laid off as team mascot when the team moved to San Jose.
Never takes the head off. The head is the brand.

characters.name: Count Kickflip
bio: Only skates at night, or under Karl the Fog.
Rent-controlled crypt in North Beach since 1906.

characters.name: Mr. Bones
bio: Waited for the 38 Geary until he was just bones.
Lightest skater in SoMa. Rattles down every handrail.

characters.name: Tech Bro
bio: Pre-seed, pre-revenue, pre-kickflip. Founder of Pivotly.
Commutes on his board from a $4,800 studio.

characters.name: Karl the Fog
bio: Rolls into Dolores every afternoon around four, uninvited.
Has more followers than you. Cancels every Fourth of July.

characters.name: Mission Burrito
bio: Born on Mission St at 2 a.m., wrapped in foil, extra salsa.
Weighs three pounds. Rice inside? We don't talk about it.

characters.name: The Pigeon
bio: Runs Dolores Park. Has never paid rent anywhere.
Will steal your burrito, then kickflip off your robotaxi.

characters.name: The Robotaxi

unlock.hint: Find 3 secret tapes, or finish Unit 7 Learns to Ollie

bio: Drives itself to Dolores every morning. Brakes for plastic bags, pigeons and bad vibes.
Has never had a parking ticket. Has been coned eleven times.

style.bailSay: I'm sorry, I can't do that.

characters.name: The Cable Car

unlock.hint: Complete 20 Tour goals, or finish Sal's Turntable

bio: Climbing halfway to the stars since 1873. The bell is not a request.
Stops at every corner on Hyde. Tourists hang off the side for free.

style.bailSay: Derailed. Everybody off, walk up to Hyde.

characters.name: The Sea Lion

unlock.hint: Finish Captain Barnacle's story at Pier 39

bio: Came for the herring in 1990, never left K-Dock at Pier 39.
Barks at tourists, claps for kickflips. Smells like the bay.

style.bailSay: Belly flop. A ten from the K-Dock judges.

castView._doc: src/client/castpeople.ts: metres from the camera the cast is drawn within; from the player: they turn to face you within turnNear, show their name within tagNear (from the camera), offer a talk within talkNear; turnSpeed radians a second; within nearDetail metres every part is drawn, beyond it the baked rig (a few skinned meshes on the same bones; kit people are drawn baked even near; beyond faceBeyond the whole rig is one vertex-coloured mesh without the face, and the low preset's castSimple makes it one still mesh further off; parts smaller than shadowRadius metres cast no shadow). People built from a kit recipe (people[].kit, src/client/skater/kitpeople.ts) name their body or bird, hair, beard, hat, glasses, earrings, top, bottom, shoes, gloves, layers, props, face and idle (castpeople.ts kitIdle)

people.name: Chad Vantage
bio: Tech landlord, Hayes Valley. Fleece vest, tablet, a robotaxi fleet.
Never angry, always pivoting.

people.name: Big Lou
bio: Fog City Skate Shop, Mission. Turned pro in 1994.
Every story ends in an injury.

people.name: Marisol
bio: Filmer. Never satisfied.
"Again, but with feeling."

people.name: Gloria
bio: Permit clerk, City Hall. Forms in triplicate.
Loves rules more than life.

people.name: Grandma Wu
bio: Chinatown. The fastest grandma in SF.
Pays in dumplings.

people.name: Brayden
bio: E-scooter founder, Lombard and downtown.
A new startup every time you meet.

people.name: Sal
bio: Cable car gripman, Powell turntable.
Strong opinions about tourists.

people.name: Dolores
bio: Muni operator. Permanently delayed, permanently calm.
"We are being held."

people.name: Dre
bio: SoMa. The crew.
Trash-talks every try, his own included.

people.name: Rocco
bio: North Beach. Beat poet of Washington Square.
The fog never writes back.

people.name: Nonna Gia
bio: North Beach. Café owner on Columbus.
Forty years of espresso. Never expresso.

people.name: Vito
bio: North Beach. Bocce player since 1961.
Too comfortable to fetch the ball.

people.name: Mo
bio: Russian Hill. Hyde St cable car brakeman.
Trusts nothing that rolls.

people.name: Mrs. Fitch
bio: Russian Hill. Guards the last hydrangea on Lombard St.
Guards the last hydrangea on Lombard St.

people.name: Gus
bio: Fisherman's Wharf. Living statue at Fisherman's Wharf since 1987.
Can't feel his legs.

people.name: Steve
bio: Fisherman's Wharf. A seagull.
Steals fries. It's a calling.

people.name: Kenny
bio: Chinatown. Leads a lion dance troupe.
The lion is two guys.

people.name: Auntie Mei
bio: Chinatown. Dim sum cart auntie on Grant Ave.
Everyone is too skinny.

people.name: Trent
bio: Financial District. Finance bro.
Always forty-five seconds from a meeting.

people.name: Farmer June
bio: The Embarcadero. Stone-fruit farmer at the Ferry Building market.
Chefs fear her.

people.name: Vinny
bio: Downtown. The Pigeon's cousin.
Runs Powell St.

people.name: Tiffany
bio: Downtown. Shopaholic.
Her robotaxi quit on her, emotionally.

people.name: Xóchitl
bio: Calle 24. Muralist on Calle 24.
Paints you better than you are.

people.name: Don Beto
bio: Calle 24. Baker on 24th St.
Cold conchas make him sad.

people.name: Tío Memo
bio: Calle 24. Lowrider owner.
His car hops higher than you.

people.name: Don Ramón
bio: The Mission. Mariachi band leader.
His trumpet player is on the 14 Mission.

people.name: Lupita
bio: The Mission. Paleta vendor.
Racing the sun every day.

people.name: Abuela Rosaura
bio: The Mission. Grandmother.
Her chancla has range.

people.name: Priya
bio: Duboce Triangle. Dog walker.
Nine dogs. All of them are the corgi.

people.name: Ezra
bio: Duboce Triangle. Brews kombucha.
It is alive, legally.

people.name: Dr. Gravity
bio: Duboce Triangle. Physicist.
Thinks skaters cannot fly. Hopes he is wrong.

people.name: Dez
bio: Lower Haight. Record store clerk on Haight.
His demo is mostly feedback.

people.name: Philippa
bio: Hayes Valley. Art critic at Patricia's Green.
Everything is a metaphor.

people.name: Benny
bio: Lower Haight. Sandwich shop on Haight St.
Names every sandwich after a regular.

people.name: Juniper
bio: Lower Haight. Bike messenger.
Rides the Wiggle. Does not believe in brakes.

people.name: Mr. Lau
bio: Chinatown. Writes the fortunes for a cookie bakery.
Fifty years. Writer's block.

people.name: Pistachio
bio: Telegraph Hill. One of the wild parrots of Telegraph Hill.
Knows one word. The word is mid.

people.name: Herb
bio: The Embarcadero. Cruise ship tourist from Ohio.
Four hours ashore. Linda has the camera.

people.name: Bernadette
bio: Telegraph Hill. Coit Tower tour guide.
Her group took scooters. She did not.

people.name: Rosa
bio: SoMa. Deadpan.
The best skater in SoMa. Everything is "mid".

people.name: Kenji
bio: SoMa. The crew.
Loses boards.

people.name: Hector
bio: The Mission. Taqueria owner.
Treats every burrito as a sacred promise.

people.name: Tash
bio: The Mission. The crew.
Always filming on a flip phone. Thinks it is art.

people.name: Donna
bio: The Castro. Roller-disco legend.
Rolling the Castro since the Carter administration.

people.name: Bev
bio: The Castro. Crossing guard of the rainbow crosswalk.
Believes it is a runway.

people.name: Skye
bio: Hayes Valley. Influencer.
Wants you candid, but on purpose.

people.name: Marge
bio: The Embarcadero. Chowder vendor.
Hates seagulls more than anything.

people.name: Supervisor Okafor
bio: Civic Center. Chairs the Board of Supervisors.
Has read every page of every permit. Tired.

people.name: Supervisor Pham
bio: Civic Center. Supervisor for the district.
Accidentally loves skateboarding.

people.name: Supervisor Delgado
bio: Civic Center. Supervisor.
Sees a liability in everything, and secretly a ramp.

people.name: Jasper
bio: Mission Dolores. Strung the slackline between two Dolores trees.
Has fallen off both.

people.name: Gideon
bio: Noe Valley. Noe Valley dad.
The twins are finally asleep. He cannot move.

people.name: Misty
bio: Twin Peaks. Karl the Fog's cousin.
Gets Twin Peaks and the tourists. Mostly the tourists.

people.name: Walter
bio: Mission Dolores. Waiting for the J Church since 2009.
Optimistic.

people.name: Lorraine
bio: Civic Center. Her pug, Mayor Biscuits, runs Market Street.
She just walks behind him.

people.name: Ruth
bio: Civic Center. Beekeeper at the UN Plaza farmers market.
The bees are on a field trip.

people.name: Doña Chela
bio: Calle 24. Sells churros at the 24th St BART plaza.
A churro without sugar is a stick.

people.name: Mrs. Haverford
bio: Civic Center. Mother of the bride.
The wedding shoot on the City Hall steps is hers now.

people.name: Lev
bio: Downtown. Speed-chess hustler on Market Street.
Has not bought his own coffee since 1988.

people.name: Kevin
bio: SoMa. Drives a Three Bin Hauling truck.
Bombs Dolores on his lunch break. Today Dolores bombed him.

people.name: Bjorn
bio: Civic Center. Tourist from Stockholm with a paper map from 1987.
Confident.
